goal: Prevent stalled or trickling HTTP clients from holding RPC connection slots indefinitely
Stops slow unauthenticated requests from exhausting available slots and blocking legitimate RPC clients
reviewability: Review is waiting on the author to answer an open objection regarding test assertions
agreement: Unaddressed objection: test assertion could hide premature socket reclamation (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it prevents unauthenticated connection slot exhaustion from stalled HTTP clients
Practical impact is low because the RPC port binds to localhost by default
